# Growth content skill

Reuse the planned SEO/I18N module #44, and check existing screens and contracts. Write **drafts** with audience, message, testable claims, locale and accessibility evidence. Never invent customer testimonials, benchmarks, certifications, pricing guarantees or research citations.

No content publishing, ad purchase or analytics pixel activation. Keep campaigns opt-in, third-party free, compatible with the generated Next.js app and its neutral templates. Measure with the privacy-aware module #41 once verified.
